text: Overlapping or contradictory regulation raises the risk of selective enforcement and legal arbitrage, because entities that cannot be expected to comply with everything can instead exploit the gaps and inconsistencies to their advantage.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Future of Law - Dynamic Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4957318

isBasedOn.name: The Future of Law - Dynamic Web3 Governance

abstract: When individuals and businesses struggle to understand and adhere to overlapping or contradictory regulations, the risk of selective enforcement and legal arbitrage rises, where entities exploit legal gaps and inconsistencies to their advantage.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: where regulated parties cannot readily understand the full body of applicable rules
